verdict.rationale: Glama has an API reference page for searching its catalog and syncing directories, but nothing shows that reference is interactive or has runnable examples, and no OpenAPI or Swagger spec was found. The browser MCP Inspector tests third-party MCP servers. It is an adjacent feature, not an interactive reference for Glama's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
